login_description: Sign in to your family photo library.
login_retry_in: You can try again in {seconds} seconds.
login_pairing_qr_note: Pairing a phone by scanning a QR code arrives with the mobile app.
login_pairing_url_note: You can also sign in on the mobile app by entering this server's address.
nav_coming_later: The remaining sections arrive in a later update.
welcome_body: The web app skeleton is running. The photo views are on their way; the timeline placeholder pins where they will live.
setup_already_completed: Setup is already complete. Please sign in.
validation_failed: Please check your entries and try again.
internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
auth_invalid_credentials: Incorrect email or password. Please try again.
auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
pairing_token_invalid: This pairing code is invalid or has expired.
asset_too_large: This file is larger than the upload limit.
auth_forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.
user_email_taken: An account with this email address already exists.
model_download_failed: The model download could not be started. Check the server logs and try again.
model_invalid: This model cannot be used for the requested action. Check its files and activation state.
person_not_found: This person does not exist or is not visible to you.
album_not_found: This album does not exist or is not visible to you.
album_locked: This album is locked. Unlock it before editing it.
person_hide_requires_label: Name this person before hiding them.
album_cover_not_member: The cover photo must be a photo in this album.
album_share_to_owner: This album is already yours -- it cannot be shared to its own owner.
album_share_user_invalid: That account cannot be shared to.
album_pref_not_excludable: This album cannot be excluded from your timeline.
tag_not_found: This tag does not exist or is not visible to you.
tag_name_taken: You already have another tag with this name.
timeline_empty: Your timeline is empty. Photos you upload appear here.
session_expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
upload_active_count: {count, plural, one {# in flight} other {# in flight}}
upload_conflict_body: A copy of "{name}" is already in the trash. Restore that copy, or keep only the new upload.
viewer_processing: This video is still processing. It plays as soon as it is ready.
viewer_trashed_notice: This photo is in the trash.
viewer_hidden_notice: This photo is hidden from the timeline.
viewer_faces_placeholder: No people recognized in this photo.
viewer_places_placeholder: Places arrive in a later update.
trash_note: Deleted photos stay here until their retention runs out, then they are removed for good.
trash_empty: The trash is empty. Photos you delete appear here before they are removed for good.
trash_remaining_days: {count, plural, =0 {Expiring soon} one {# day left} other {# days left}}
trash_delete_body: "{name}" will be deleted forever, together with its file. This cannot be undone.
favorites_empty: No favorites yet. Star a photo to keep it here.
hidden_empty: Nothing is hidden. Photos you hide stay out of the timeline and appear here.
admin_users_disable_body: {name} will be signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until you re-enable the account.
admin_users_create_note: The new account can sign in and upload right away.
admin_models_note: The machine learning models this instance uses. The default group downloads from upstream once; custom models register from the server's models directory.
admin_models_slot_empty: No model registered for this slot.
admin_models_empty_body: The default model group has not been downloaded. Face detection, face recognition, semantic search and text recognition stay off until it lands.
admin_models_download_queued: Waiting for the download to start…
admin_models_download_failed_run: The download failed. Try again to rejoin the run; its own retries may recover it.
admin_models_activate_body_same: {name} becomes the active {slot} model. The previous model's products are kept -- switching back restores them -- but the new model needs a rerun over the library before its products appear.
admin_models_activate_body_cross: {name} becomes the active {slot} model with a different embedding dimension: every embedding is deleted and the vector column is re-typed. The whole library needs a rerun; switching back does not bring the deleted embeddings back.
admin_models_wiped_notice: Activated with the vector dimension changed from {from} to {to}: {count} embeddings were removed. Rerun the embeddings to rebuild them.
admin_models_rerun_title: Rerun this model over the library?
admin_models_rerun_body: One background run redoes {slot} for every ready image with the active model. Follow it on the task panel.
admin_jobs_note: The instance's background runs, newest first.
albums_empty: No albums yet. Create one to gather photos around a moment.
albums_detail_empty: This album has no photos yet. Add some from your timeline.
albums_delete_body: "{title}" goes, together with its photo list and its shares. The photos themselves stay in your library.
albums_locked_notice: Locked. Curation and edits stay off until you unlock it.
albums_excluded_notice: This album's photos stay out of your timeline.
albums_rescan_note: Directory albums arrive in a later update.
albums_cover_body: Pick a photo from this album.
albums_cover_empty: This album has no photos yet.
albums_share_body: Everyone listed below can see this album and its photos.
albums_add_empty: You have no albums of your own yet.
people_empty: No people yet. Photos with faces will show up here.
people_unnamed_empty: Nothing to name yet. Face clusters appear here once faces are grouped.
people_merge_body: The selected clusters fold into one person. Merged clusters disappear and their names are lost.
people_merge_no_target: Pick an existing person to merge into, or select one more cluster.
people_merge_into_body: This person merges into the one you pick. This cluster disappears and its name is lost.
people_picker_empty: No other person is available yet.
people_move_body: Pick the person this face joins.
people_hidden_notice: Hidden. They stay in your people list with a badge.
viewer_assign_body: Pick the person this face belongs to.
viewer_assign_note: This names the whole group: every face grouped with this one shares the name.
viewer_face_not_grouped: This face has not been grouped yet, so it cannot be assigned. Try again once grouping finishes.
search_query_placeholder: Search your photos — words and meaning both work
search_result_count_so_far: {count, plural, one {# result so far} other {# results so far}}
search_result_note: Each filter's count shows the photos the other filters leave visible.
search_empty_body: Try different words, or clear some filters. Semantic search understands descriptions like "sunset at the beach".
places_head_sub: {cities, plural, one {# city} other {# cities}} · {photos, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}
places_map_placeholder: The map view arrives with a self-hosted tile decision in a later update — the city grouping comes first.
places_empty_body: Photos whose GPS resolves to a city appear here, grouped by city.
